node.title: F2 selector-face primitive reduction
node.statement: For every nonempty antipodal-selector syndrome fiber on a power-of-two half-system, factor the selector roots corresponding to coordinates fixed throughout the fiber. Unless the fiber is a singleton, division embeds it into a punctured split-locator prefix fiber of codimension 2R whose selector subfamily is gcd-trivial and aperiodic. If primitive master flatness is uniform under these punctures, then the max fiber is at most P_*(2m)(1+2^(2 max(Delta,0))), Delta=m-R log_2|K|. Hence polynomial primitive flatness gives 2^o(m) F2 weighted mass at the saturated windows. No master-flatness, first-match, PP5.0, or finite n^3 claim is made.
